approach: Add crates/athena-core/tests/learnings_recorded.rs, modelled on model_roster.rs and buy_first.rs. It reads studies/firstmate-work-handling/rationales.json (parsed with serde_json, a normal athena-core dependency) and README.md through CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR/../.. . Two pure checking functions take text and return a list of problems: `rationale_problems(&str)` and `attribution_problems(&str)`. Each runs on the real file, which must give no problems, and on a mutated copy (one tradeoff emptied; the CC BY 4.0 line removed), which must give a problem. A spec test follows the model_roster.rs pattern: OLY-B-A3-02 is not `mechanism = "none"`, names the test file and the Hermes gap, has owner "Athena", and the measure names the command and ends `status: not shown`. Then fill the spec entry, add the CHANGELOG line, add the test-unit line to xtask/shard-timings.txt (the timing-units mirror rule in mirrors.rs:157-236 refuses a test file with no line), and extend the requirements-map A3-2 row without changing its Partial status.

decisions.choice: Check the rationale records and the attribution with two text-in, problems-out functions in the test file, and run each on the real file and on a mutated copy.
decisions.reason: The mutation cases run the same checking code the real-file case runs, so the test fails when the mechanism is removed and passes with it. No logic sits in a double. Same shape as a_copy_without_haiku_is_refused_by_the_loader in model_roster.rs:36-48.

rejected.option: Assert only that the files exist or contain a word.
rejected.why: That checks wiring, not the learnings-with-rationale behavior (user default behavior-evidence).

rejected.option: Add a new Rust check function in athena-core/src or a new record schema.
rejected.why: The brief calls for an integration test; a src change would touch check_record_file and AnyRecord and widen the change.

decisions.choice: The measure ends `status: not shown` and names `cargo test -p athena-core --test learnings_recorded`; the mechanism text states that Hermes has no study records yet.
decisions.reason: No line of `athena status` reports this property, so the only allowed label is `not shown` (status.rs ~302). The Hermes gap is a recorded fact (requirements-map.md:153 says Hermes is not studied).

rejected.option: Add a new status label to STATUS_MEASURE_LABELS.
rejected.why: Out of scope; it would change status.rs and its tests.

decisions.choice: Require each rationale record to have a non-empty decision, tradeoff and provenance, a non-empty alternatives array, and a non-empty sources array. Also require the schema string study.rationale/1 and at least one record.
decisions.reason: Matches the fields in rationales.json (lines 3-17), where all six records carry them. `authors_say` may be null (line 45), so it is not required.

rejected.why: authors_say is legitimately null in ra3; requiring it would fail the real file.

decisions.choice: Check the attribution with the three strings in README.md lines 322-324: `Harness Engineering`, `https://github.com/lopopolo/harness-engineering`, and `CC BY 4.0`, all required.
decisions.reason: The requirement says the bundle's influence is attributed under its license; README.md is where that attribution lives. The mutation removes the license text, so the license check is what fails.

rejected.why: The brief names README.md only; one source keeps the test small.

decisions.choice: Add one line `athena-core --test learnings_recorded 5.00` to xtask/shard-timings.txt, and name it in the plan as a necessary mirror outside the brief's deliverable list.
decisions.reason: missing_timing_lines (mirrors.rs:206-236) refuses a test unit that has no timing line, and the existing tests are listed at xtask/shard-timings.txt:52-55. It is not a governance, tool or lint configuration file.

rejected.why: The mirror check would fail the job.

decisions.reason: Hermes is unstudied, so the row is still partial. roadmap.md:124 and strategy-view.md:108 list A3-2 as Partial, and they stay consistent.

rejected.why: It would be untrue: Hermes has no records.

steps: Create crates/athena-core/tests/learnings_recorded.rs with module docs naming OLY-B-A3-02 and a `repo_file` helper copied from model_roster.rs:11-16. Add `rationale_problems(text: &str) -> Vec<String>`, which parses with serde_json, requires an array with at least one record, and per record reports an empty `decision`, `tradeoff` or `provenance`, an empty `alternatives` or `sources` array, and a wrong `schema`. Add `attribution_problems(text: &str) -> Vec<String>`, which reports each missing string of `Harness Engineering`, `https://github.com/lopopolo/harness-engineering` and `CC BY 4.0`.

Add the tests: the real rationales pass; the real README passes; the mutation tests (first `"tradeoff": "..."` value emptied, `CC BY 4.0` removed), each asserting first that its target is present in the real text; and `spec_entry_has_a_real_mechanism` following model_roster.rs:51-68 with the extra assertions on the test file name, Hermes, the command and the measure ending `status: not shown`.

Edit docs/spec.toml lines 2543 and 2545 only. Mechanism: `A test, crates/athena-core/tests/learnings_recorded.rs, checks that every firstmate rationale record in studies/firstmate-work-handling/rationales.json has a decision, alternatives, tradeoff, provenance and a source, and that README.md attributes the harness-engineering bundle under CC BY 4.0. Hermes has no study records yet, so what Athena learns from Hermes is not covered.` Measure: `Firstmate rationale records carry rationale and the bundle is attributed in the README; cargo test -p athena-core --test learnings_recorded; status: not shown`. Leave the owner, statement, kind, status and sources unchanged.

Add `athena-core --test learnings_recorded 5.00` to xtask/shard-timings.txt in sorted position, after `athena-core --lib 15.00` and before `athena-core --test model_roster 5.00`. Order is by name, so the line goes between the `external_calls_guard` and `model_roster` lines (lines 53-54).

Add a bullet to the top of `### Added` under `## [Unreleased]` in CHANGELOG.md, in the form of the lines at CHANGELOG.md:12-18: OLY-B-A3-02 now has a mechanism (the test file), what it checks, the Hermes gap, and that the measure ends `status: not shown`. State that no refusal rule and no config changes.

In docs/design/requirements-map.md line 113, add `crates/athena-core/tests/learnings_recorded.rs` to the 'where answered' column and keep `Partial: firstmate work handling only` (add 'Hermes not studied').
Run `cargo fmt --all --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` and `cargo test --locked`, and fix any finding in the files above.

demonstrations.method: The test reads docs/spec.toml, slices the OLY-B-A3-02 entry as model_roster.rs:51-68 does, and asserts the entry has no `mechanism = "none"`. It also checks that the entry contains `crates/athena-core/tests/learnings_recorded.rs`, the word Hermes, `owner = "Athena"`, and the command `cargo test -p athena-core --test learnings_recorded`. Finally it asserts the measure line ends with `status: not shown`.
demonstrations.observes: The test passes on the edited spec. On the base spec (mechanism = "none", measure `... status: requirement`) it fails on the first assertion.
demonstrations.fails_without: Reverting the spec entry to mechanism = "none" fails the first assertion.
demonstrations.seam: Entry point: the integration test reading the real docs/spec.toml through the `repo_file` helper (pattern exists in model_roster.rs:11-16; this test file adds its own copy in step 1). No fake is used.

demonstrations.method: The test calls `rationale_problems` on the real studies/firstmate-work-handling/rationales.json text. The function parses it with serde_json and, for each record, requires a non-empty `decision`, `tradeoff` and `provenance`, and non-empty `alternatives` and `sources` arrays. It also requires at least one record. The test asserts the returned list is empty.
demonstrations.observes: Six records (count seen in the file) pass with no problems. Emptying any field in a copy produces a named problem such as `ra1: tradeoff is empty`.
demonstrations.fails_without: If a record lost its tradeoff, or the check function were a no-op that returned a problem for nothing, the mutation test in criterion 4 would fail.
demonstrations.seam: The production entry point is the checking function in the test file, driven by the real file read with `repo_file`. The function is added by step 1. No double is used.

demonstrations.method: The test calls `attribution_problems` on the real README.md text and requires the three strings: `Harness Engineering`, `https://github.com/lopopolo/harness-engineering` and `CC BY 4.0`. The spec-entry test in criterion 1 covers the third part of the criterion, that the spec entry is not `mechanism = "none"`.
demonstrations.observes: The real README.md (lines 322-324) passes with no problems.
demonstrations.fails_without: A README without the license text makes `attribution_problems` return a problem; criterion 4 shows this.
demonstrations.seam: The same `repo_file` helper reads README.md. The checker function is added by step 1. No fake is used.

demonstrations.method: Two mutation tests run the checking functions on edited copies of the real text. (a) The rationales text with the first `tradeoff` value replaced by an empty string must give a problem naming that record, and the real text must give none. (b) The README text with `CC BY 4.0` removed (the `[CC BY 4.0](...)` line replaced) must give a problem naming the license, and the real text must give none. Each test first asserts that the string it removes is present in the real text, so a mutation that changes nothing cannot pass.
demonstrations.observes: All tests pass. Mutated copies report problems and real files report none; the same checking functions are used in both.
demonstrations.fails_without: A checking function that does not read the fields (always returns an empty list) fails the mutation tests, because the mutated copies would report no problem.
demonstrations.seam: The checking functions `rationale_problems` and `attribution_problems` are called directly with a text value. The mutated text is made with `str::replacen` on the real file text. The seam is added by step 1; no doubles.

demonstrations.method: Run the three Athena checks on the final tree. The new test file uses `expect`/`panic!` only in the style of model_roster.rs, which already passes clippy under the workspace lints; the producer runs clippy on the test target and fixes any lint it raises.

demonstrations.seam: Entry points are the repository's own cargo commands. No seam is needed.
